utterances.en: Oh, well, it's not going to be a fair fight.
utterances.zh: 噢，这可就难招架了。

utterances.en: If Zheng's able to use that sort of finesse
utterances.zh: 如果郑钦文能拿出这种细腻手感，

utterances.en: to go along with her power.
utterances.zh: 再配上她的力量。

utterances.en: She gets it done.
utterances.zh: 她拿下了这一分。

utterances.en: Winners number 12, 13, 14 and 15
utterances.zh: 第十二至十五记制胜分，

utterances.en: in this opening set.
utterances.zh: 都是在这第一盘里。

utterances.en: And the mishit from Mertens,
utterances.zh: 梅尔滕斯这一拍打偏了，

utterances.en: and Zheng Qinwen delights the Beijing faithful.
utterances.zh: 郑钦文让北京球迷欢呼。

utterances.en: It looked like it was going to be a beatdown
utterances.zh: 原以为会是一边倒，

utterances.en: in the opening 15, 16 minutes.
utterances.zh: 在开头十五六分钟的时候。

utterances.en: It turned out to be anything but.
utterances.zh: 结果却完全不是这样。

utterances.en: But in the end, the Queen comes through in her court
utterances.zh: 最终，女王在主场闯过这一关，

utterances.en: and has a one-set lead in semifinal number two.
utterances.zh: 在第二场半决赛中先赢一盘。

utterances.en: And even more dominant start to the set than it was in the first.
utterances.zh: 这一盘的开局比第一盘更强势。

utterances.en: Oh, that'll seal the deal on a 5-2 lead.
utterances.zh: 这一拍锁定了五比二的领先。

utterances.en: And Zheng Qinwen wakes up the crowd once again in Beijing.
utterances.zh: 郑钦文又一次点燃了北京的观众。

utterances.en: And in the end, Elise Mertens ran out of gas.
utterances.zh: 到了最后，梅尔滕斯有些后劲不足了。

utterances.en: Zheng Qinwen never took her foot off it.
utterances.zh: 郑钦文始终没有松劲。

utterances.en: And China has a finalist at the China Open for the first time.
utterances.zh: 中国球员首次闯进中网女单决赛。

utterances.en: Another quality win for Zheng Qinwen as she topples a top-20 opponent.
utterances.zh: 又一场胜利，她击败世界前二十。

utterances.en: And she is to the last day of this WTA 1000 event in the Chinese capital.
utterances.zh: 她将登上北京一千赛的决赛舞台。
